subject: RECOVERED INTEGRATION TEST: BackupReceipt overlay passes 25/25 + existing shadow validator
body: Proposed non-authoritative overlay was applied to a copy of Shadow Trial SP1: backup-receipt.schema.json + semantic validator + 13 BackupReceipt tests.
